description: React component for creating a dialog to start a new evaluation, including form steps for dataset selection, evaluators, and LLM grading options.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Resets all form state variables to initial values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates current form data based on the active step.

methods.name: goNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step if validation passes; triggers evaluation creation on last step.

methods.name: createNewEvaluation
methods.description: Constructs evaluation object and calls onConfirm callback.

methods.name: disableButton
methods.description: Determines if the next/submit button should be disabled based on form validation.

methods.name: EvalWizard
methods.description: Renders the stepper component indicating current progress.

methods.name: selectLLMForEval
methods.description: Handles selection of LLM for grading, fetches models if needed.

methods.name: onChangeFlowType
methods.description: Updates flow type filters based on checkbox toggles.

methods.name: populateFlowNames
methods.description: Transforms flow data into options with labels and types.

methods.name: populateAssistants
methods.description: Transforms assistant data into options with labels and types.
